title: Distro manifest
description: One distro's user-data, in src/manifests/<distro>.json: the release version and the fragments it's built from. The file's name is the WSL distribution's name, such as Ubuntu-26.04, which is also the default instance name from wsl --install, and the build writes dist/<distro>.user-data. The WSL datasource reads that user-data only for an instance with that name.

version.description: The version of the release the distro's user-data is published in, in Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 without a v prefix. Every manifest has the same version. Bump it in every change that changes what's built into dist/.

description.description: A sentence saying what the distro's user-data is for.

fragments.description: Every fragment in the distro's user-data, in the order cloud-init merges them. Each is the name of a file in src/fragments/ without .user-data. List each fragment once.
